response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

assumptions.assumption: Each media type's average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes divided by total milliseconds); the outer value is the unweighted mean across media types that have at least one qualifying track.
Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division; Milliseconds is NOT NULL and assumed non-zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type average computed as ratio of sums (SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds)) rather than mean of per-track ratios, then simple average across media types.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(r) FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x
